title: Sync Generator
description: A type definition for the Razorwind - Sync generator's options

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The mode to use when running Razorwind generate

configFile.title: Razorwind Config File
configFile.description: The path to the Razorwind config file to use when running generate. If not provided, the default config file will be used.

targetName.title: Target Name
targetName.description: The name of the target to use when running Razorwind generate

outOfSyncMessage.title: Out of Sync Message
outOfSyncMessage.description: The message to display when Razorwind generated files are out of sync
outOfSyncMessage.default: Razorwind generated files are out of sync. Run `nx sync` to regenerate.

default.outOfSyncMessage: Razorwind generated files are out of sync. Run `nx sync` to regenerate.
